purpose: Define peer reachability as derived transient network evidence, distinct from identity, presence, authentication, authorization and application readiness.

topics.name: Peer Reachability State
topics.purpose: Define peer reachability as derived transient network evidence, distinct from identity, presence, authentication, authorization and application readiness.

semantics.identity_rule: Reachability attaches to exact peer/transport observation context.
semantics.presence_rule: Reachable does not necessarily mean user/application presence.
semantics.multi_path_rule: Multiple candidate paths remain separate evidence.

invariants.rule: Listener, route, endpoint, connection, channel, peer reachability and cryptographic transport evidence never by themselves grant application, data or operation authority.
Inbound network data remains inert until explicit protocol parsing, validation, identity/context resolution, authorization and dispatcher routing succeed.

hard_gates.condition: one failed path marks all peers invalid
